The '''Doan Royal Guard''' was the guard of the [[Doan Royal House]]. [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], a member of the [[Gloom Walkers]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], became the [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] of [[Serra]], and later joined the [[Doan]] Royal Guard after Serra's marriage to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jedder]], a senior member of the Royal Guard, was sent by Serra to assist the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] known as [[Darth Cognus|the Huntress]] to [[Skirmish in Darth Bane's mansion|capture]] [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]].
